title: Nice for a flower girl..Do not look real inside the house.
text:
Nice for a flower girl..Do not look real inside the house.. I didn't buy these rose petals for a wedding.
I bought these to put in a glass heart shaped bowl to put on my outdoor coffee table for the summer.
Although I have brought them in the house. To me they do not look real..

There not silk, there more of a material type of fabric with some texture to them. They have some lines , and
are a bit of scalloped to the pedal. The fabric is thin.
I would think they would look nice for a flower girl to throw these pedals down the isle.
Or throw them on the bed, for a sexy night!

The reason for the 3 stars is, I thought these would be a darker red, like Red Roses.
There a lighter red..and do not look real.

I didn't smell any fragrance to these at all.
I spray them with perfume incase someone smelled them, and to give the room a nice fragrance.
When there outside, the air doesnt give them off a scent.
